## README.md
# NOAA CoastWatch satellite ocean colour

Monthly chlorophyll-a and Kd490 water clarity from NASA's Aqua MODIS sensor, as served by [NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP](https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/), on a global 4 km grid from January 2003. Each product is published as an H3 hexagon table at resolution 6 and as one Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF per month.

STAC: `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-coastwatch/stac-collection.json`

| dataset | variable | units | months | cell value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `erdMH1chlamday` | `chlorophyll` | mg m-3 | 2003-01 to 2022-03 (230) | mean of the 4 km pixels |
| `erdMH1kd490mday` | `k490` | m-1 | 2003-01 to 2022-05 (232) | mean of the 4 km pixels |

```
<dataset>/hex/h0=<cell>/data_0.parquet          # columns: h6, h0, time, <variable>
<dataset>/cog/<dataset>-YYYYMM.tif              # WGS84, Float32, missing pixels are NaN
raw/<dataset>/nc/<dataset>-YYYYMM.nc.gz         # the netCDF as delivered by ERDDAP, gzipped
raw/<dataset>/nc/<dataset>-YYYYMM.nc.gz.json    # request URL, access time, size and SHA-256 before gzipping
raw/<dataset>/zarr/<dataset>-YYYYMM.zarr/       # the same array as Zarr, read by the hex build
```

`time` is the 16th of the month, as upstream stamps its monthly composites. Cells with no valid retrieval in a month (cloud, sun glint, sea ice, land) have no row. There is no `h8` column, because a 4 km pixel is coarser than an H3 resolution 8 cell; join resolution 8 data with `h3_cell_to_parent(h8, 6)`. The values are concentrations and coefficients, so summarise a region with an area-weighted mean and never a sum.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;
SELECT time, avg(chlorophyll) AS mean_of_cells, count(*) AS cells
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-coastwatch/erdMH1chlamday/hex/h0=*/*.parquet')
WHERE time BETWEEN DATE '2015-01-01' AND DATE '2015-12-31'
  AND h0 = h3_cell_to_parent(h3_latlng_to_cell(21.3, -157.8, 6), 0)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;
```

The unweighted `avg` above is a quick look only; weight by cell area for a regional statistic.

## MapLibre GL JS

The COGs are rasters, not vector tiles, so they have no `source-layer`. Serve one through a COG tiler such as titiler:

```js
map.addSource('chl', {
  type: 'raster',
  tiles: ['https://<titiler>/cog/tiles/WebMercatorQuad/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?url=' +
          encodeURIComponent('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-coastwatch/erdMH1chlamday/cog/erdMH1chlamday-202203.tif') +
          '&rescale=0.01,10&colormap_name=viridis'],
  tileSize: 256
});
map.addLayer({ id: 'chl', type: 'raster', source: 'chl' });
```
